title: [Prime] Ninja Crispi Pro 6-in-1 Glass Air Fryer, 5.7l, Cyberspace $122.55 Delivered @ Amazon AU
body:
Deal: [Prime] Ninja Crispi Pro 6-in-1 Glass Air Fryer, 5.7l, Cyberspace $122.55 Delivered @ Amazon AU

[n8te] doesn't look like it - even in incognito it's still showing in stock for me
[Blacklist] @Blacklist: It will be nice to see if amazon actually fulfill these price and deals
[suku1809] Thanks OP. Bought one. Couldn't get the discount though. But even at $122 is a very good price.
Last checked still one available.
[krisspy] Wouldn't let me checkout with that last one :(
[ihbh] Good price. Add ~$25 for SS tray replacement.
[Plasma] Apparently these aftermarket trays can expand, shattering the glass.
[A female dog] Wth I ordered this at $266 a 2 weeks ago and Is still eligible for refund. If I order this can I refund via the old receipt/purchase? So annoyed at the major price difference
[A female dog] I was able to order it just before it went out of stock. I was going to keep it as a back up / spare but if am able to return using the previous receipt (ordered both on Amazon AU) I’d rather that.
[mathematicalcoffee] I've had good success politely going in chat and asking for the difference as an amazon gift card (on amazon fulfilled products) particularly if it was within a week that the price dropped. Ymmv but worth a try?
[A female dog] @mathematicalcoffee: Amazon has NEVER done this for me before, regardless of being polite or a bit more direct. I’ve had instances where I have ordered something and before it even ships, it’s gone down in price but am told to waste resources to initiate a return for a refund and to order again :/
[montorola] Are they trying to bait us? Looks like only 1 left lol but won't let me check out
[Blacklist] I feel these can be baits to get people to buy prime
[InternetCrusader] Nah, I cancelled mine. As I was able to price match at jb Hi-Fi so could pickup instantly
[rsop] Any benfits of this. Beside the Glass container. Some comments say doesnt have the same air flow
[Munki] Having used this a handful of times, I can say it's awesome for the price I paid. It's even better at this price if you got it for that.
[Plasma] This is an outrageously good price. I paid about $140 for the standard model which has been terrific.
[Munki] I just want to say, I hug my pink one sometimes cause it's so beautiful. Is that weird?
[xscape] I bought this from the last deal for about $233 and despite it being unavailable from today's deal, i jumped on chat and got a courtesy gift card for the price difference!
[xscape] Nope, literally just quoted the price that I saw from here.
After I mentioned what i paid from the last recent deal, they said they can see on their system that the current price of the item is $290.70 but when I ordered this before it was $333.00, however, I just explained that I paid 233~ (using coupons) or whatever it was and it was just on special today for $122.55 (using coupons) so they credited me the difference in a gift card! Guess i was pretty lucky considering people had hit or miss experiences.
[bcYield] The wording means "courtesy" sounds like a compensation to keep us happy. It can't happy often I guess.
[xscape] first time i've tried from memory, so i'm 1/1
[bcYield] Looks like easier to clean than other fryers. Missed it!
